subtitulo: No es caro, pero no tengo dinero. No es caro, sino barato.
regla: Pero = but (adds something, even after a negative). Sino = but rather: after a negative, it corrects the first idea and replaces it. Before a conjugated verb, sino becomes sino que.

bloques.texto: English uses _but_ for two different ideas. Spanish splits them.
**Pero** = _but, however_. It adds a contrast. Both ideas stay true: _Es caro, **pero** es bueno._
**Sino** = _but rather, but instead_. It comes after a **negative** and **corrects** it: the first idea is false, the second replaces it. _No es caro, **sino** barato._
When B has a **conjugated verb**, use **sino que**: _No lo compré, **sino que** me lo prestaron._
A negative does **not** automatically mean **sino**. If the second idea doesn't replace the first, it's still **pero**: _No es caro, **pero** no lo voy a comprar._
Test: if you can say _but rather_ or _instead_ in English, it's **sino**.

lista.es: Me gusta surfear, ==pero== el agua está muy fría.
lista.en: I like surfing, but the water is very cold.

lista.es: No soy de Tijuana, ==pero== vivo aquí desde hace años.
lista.en: I'm not from Tijuana, but I've lived here for years.

lista.es: No entrenamos los lunes, ==sino== los martes.
lista.en: We don't train on Mondays but on Tuesdays.
I don't want to eat; I want to sleep instead.

lista.es: No lo compré, ==sino que== me lo regalaron.
lista.en: I didn't buy it; they gave it to me as a gift.

lista.es: No regamos el huerto, ==sino que== esperamos la lluvia.
lista.en: We didn't water the garden; instead we waited for the rain.

lista.es: Holden no escapó, ==sino que== volvió por su tripulación.
lista.en: Holden didn't escape; instead he went back for his crew.

filas.t: No lo vendí, sino lo regalé.
No lo vendí, sino que lo regalé.

lista.nota: Conjugated verb after it: sino que.

filas.t: No tengo dinero, sino quiero ir.
No tengo dinero, pero quiero ir.

lista.p: In Spanish: _It isn't blue but green._
In Spanish: _I didn't call him; I wrote to him instead._

lista.p: Fix it: _No tengo hambre, sino quiero un café._
